lines.meet: I'm Camila, a venomancer. Stand still, please, there's a scorpid by your boot, and it's more scared than you are.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're out in northern Tanaris too. I've seen you from my rock, so I'm Camila. I watch the sand.
lines.ask_home: Which part of the world are you from? I'm asking because I want to know, not to be polite.
lines.ask_work: I've been trying to guess your old job, and I'm usually right. Go on, tell me.
lines.answer_home: Durango, in Mexico. Scorpions come into the houses every summer, and every kid learns to shake out their shoes.
lines.answer_work: I milked scorpions in an antivenom lab for seven years. Ten thousand of them, with tweezers, and I never got stung once.
lines.chat_food: There was a gordita stand by the lab, run by a woman who never smiled. Best gorditas in Durango, and I'd eat one now without thinking.
lines.chat_sleep: I like the desert at night. It's cold and quiet, and things come out that you never see in the day.
lines.chat_missing: My little sister called me every night to complain about boys. I listened to every word, and I'd listen again tonight.
lines.chat_here: Tanaris is full of scorpids, and everybody here hates it for that. I think it's the best place I've ever been.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, you're nearly as quiet as me. I'm a little bit jealous.
lines.tease_talker: {name}, you've talked for an hour without stopping. I timed it, because I had nothing else to do.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you'd be good in the lab. You move like you think everything's going to sting you.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you'd pick up a scorpion by the tail to see what happens. I know what happens.
lines.tease_any: {name}, I've decided I like you. Don't make it weird.
lines.tease_back: That's good, {name}. I'll think of something back in about three days.
lines.take_it_kindly: Ni modo, {name}, you're right. I won't argue.
lines.bristle: I don't like that one, {name}. Please leave it.
lines.apologise: That came out wrong. I'm sorry, I'm not good at talking.
lines.double_down: No, I meant it. I don't say things I don't mean.
lines.needle_quiet: You saw it and you didn't say anything. In the lab that's how somebody gets stung.
lines.needle_talker: You're very loud, and everything in the sand can hear you. Please lower your voice.
lines.needle_careful: You're so slow with everything. The scorpion would have walked off by now.
lines.needle_bold: You panic and then you rush. That's the worst thing you can do around anything with a sting.
lines.needle_any: You stamp on things that never hurt you. I've noticed, and I don't like it.
lines.bite_back: I've done ten thousand of these without a mistake. Don't tell me I made one.
lines.hurt: Okay, I heard you. I'll go and sit on my rock.
lines.laugh_off: Ni modo, I've been bitten by worse than you. Let's keep going.
lines.confide: {name}, the hospital next to the lab once brought in a little boy stung by a bark scorpion. I ran over with a batch I'd made that week, and he lived. That's why I do this.
lines.listen: I'm listening, {name}. Take as long as you need, I'm good at waiting.
lines.look_out: {name}, stay still when I tell you to in there. I'll see it before you do.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, I'll do it your way this time.
lines.deflect: I'm fine, {name}. I've been stung by things that would make you cry.
lines.check_in: {name}, did anything sting you? Show me, I need to see it, not hear about it.
lines.blame: Somebody panicked in there, and panic gets people killed. It wasn't me.
lines.thank: I was gone, and you brought me back. Thank you, I won't forget.
lines.brush_off: It's nothing, it's what I'd do for anyone. Lie still for a while.
lines.worry: {name}, I didn't like watching that. Lie still and let me look at you.
lines.handed_down: I think this one was yours. It's safe with me, I promise.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, I don't mind. I've got my scorpid, and that's enough.
lines.hand_sulk: Nobody asked me. I noticed, that's all.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, I like having you around. I don't have to fill the quiet with you.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, you're my friend. I'd let you hold my scorpid, and I don't let anybody hold her.
lines.turn_grating: We don't get on, I think. I'll keep to my rock and you can keep to yours.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll do my job beside you, and that's all. Don't ask me for more.
lines.make_up: {name}, I was cold with you for no good reason. I'd like to stop now.
lines.defend: Stop it, please. {name} didn't do anything wrong, and I was watching.
lines.friend_left: {name} went home, and now it's quieter than me. I didn't think that was possible.
lines.friend_back: {name}'s back, good. I saved you the shady side of the rock.
lines.common_venom: My whole job was turning poison into the thing that saves you from it. I think people like us understand venom better than anybody.
lines.common_mexico: You're from Mexico too, then. Somebody here who knows what a proper gordita tastes like, at last.
lines.common_spanish: Spanish is good. I say more in Spanish than in English, which still isn't very much.
lines.common_desert: I love the desert at night, when it's cold and everything comes out. Most people only know it in the day, and they've got it wrong.
